guidance.statement: EBITDA margin was sustained at 21% in Q2 FY27.

guidance.statement: EBIT percentage in Q3 is expected to be somewhere between Q1 and Q2, closer to Q1.
guidance.quote: So we expect Q3, in terms of EBIT percentage, somewhere between Q1 and Q2, I think closer to Q1 in terms of percentage.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Q4 EBIT percentage should be better than Q3.
guidance.quote: So I would assume that in Q4 EBIT percentage should be better than Q3.

guidance.statement: Further improvement in EBIT percentage is expected on an annualized basis from next year onwards.
guidance.quote: And on an annualized basis from next year onwards, we should see further improvement.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Polycarbonate resin plant commissioning remains in line with FY29 number.
guidance.quote: So we continue to remain in line with our FY29 number.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Capital expenditure for the current year is expected to be around INR 240 crore for certain assets.
guidance.quote: So there, I would expect about another INR 240 crore is what we're seeing this year.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Capital expenditure for next year is expected to be roughly in the range of INR 400 crore to INR 420 crore.

guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Targeting around 14% to 15% EBIT next year with all commissioned assets running at steady-state.
guidance.quote: we should be targeting something along the lines of about 14% to 15% EBIT.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Second half capex/capitalization is expected to be around INR 800 crore to INR 900 crore.
guidance.quote: So around INR 800 crore to INR 900 crore further in the second half.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Next year capex is projected at INR 2,200 crore to INR 2,400 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Capex for FY 2028-2029 is projected at INR 2,500 crore.
guidance.quote: INR 2,500 crore in the second year, that is FY 2028-2029
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Balance capex in the third year will be in the range of INR 2,500 crore to INR 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: and balance in the third year, which will be in the range of INR 2,500 crore -INR 3,000 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: The company expects to spend around INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year.
guidance.quote: Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Further capital expenditure planned for this year and next year is another INR 3,000 crore.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins and gross numbers will improve in FY27.

guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta
